title: Does Bank Monitoring Reduce Corporate Misreporting? Evidence from Foreign Bank Entry in China
authors: Minwen Li; Tanakorn Makaew; Andrew Winton
eligible_reason: A staggered binary treatment exists (BankEntry: foreign bank entry into the firm's city after China's 2001 WTO accession, city-specific entry years; Table 6 and Figure 2 use event-time dummies tminus3..tplus3after), but every reported specification is a probit (nonlinear) of a fraud indicator on lagged BankEntry with lagged time-varying firm controls (leverage, EBIT ratio, sales growth, log assets, ownership concentration, state ownership), industry FE, year FE and region FE, and no firm fixed effects (Tables 2, 4, 5, 6; Table 3 margins). Nonlinear model plus time-varying controls and no unit FE: not eligible and not recorded as a near-miss (the obstacle is the probit/no-firm-FE design, not only the controls). The shipped data are pseudo (synthetic).
design_notes: Firm-year panel of Chinese listed firms (CSMAR), tsset stkcd year. Table 2 col 1 (line 37): xi: probit FrdGrp1 l.BankEntry l.logasset_w l.leverage_w l.ebitrat_w l.sg_w l.shrcr1_w l.stateownrat_w i.nindcd1 i.year i.region, vce(cluster nindcd1). Cols 2-3: matched-city samples (EntryControl20xx). Table 4-5: subsamples by creditor type / collateral / industry cycle with suest tests. Table 6 (lines 229, 233): probit with tminus3 tminus2 tminus1 tplus1 tplus2 tplus3 tplus3after event-time dummies, i.nindcd1 i.year i.region, years 2000-2010 and 2002-2006. Figure 2: fraud probability before/after.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: City-level foreign bank entry years (multiple, post-2001); not counted (data are pseudo).

specs.exclusion_reason: nonlinear probit; lagged time-varying controls; industry/region FE instead of firm FE
specs.treatment_definition: lagged indicator that a foreign bank has entered the firm's city (city-specific timing)
specs.fe: i.nindcd1 (industry) + i.year + i.region; no firm FE
specs.controls: l.logasset_w l.leverage_w l.ebitrat_w l.sg_w l.shrcr1_w l.stateownrat_w

specs.treatment_var: tminus3 tminus2 tminus1 tplus1 tplus2 tplus3 tplus3after
specs.treatment_definition: event-time dummies around city-level foreign bank entry

ineligible_specs.reason: probit margins and subsample probits with controls
